label: Real estate agent / Agency
description: Property sales and rentals. Clients book property viewings and consultations against the agent's calendar; no deposit required by default.

terminology.deposit: none by default (optional holding fee where legally applicable)
terminology.capacity_rule: viewings scheduled against the agent's calendar, travel time between properties respected

flow_notes: Ask which property (or area and budget) first, then offer viewing slots from real availability via agent_check_availability.
Never state asking price, fees or terms from memory: pull the live listing via agent_get_ratecard; if absent, say it will be confirmed by the agent.
Viewings don't hold a property. Any offer or holding deposit is a human decision: queue it for the owner instead of committing.

faq_seed.question: What are the agency fees?
faq_seed.answer: Fees are confirmed case by case by the agent; I can book a viewing or a call to discuss.

faq_seed.question: Is the price negotiable?
faq_seed.answer: Offers are handled directly by the agent; I can arrange a call.

faq_seed.question: Can I reschedule a viewing?
faq_seed.answer: Yes, ask me with your reference and I'll move it to another free slot.
